items.title: Frank Foster — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History
items.q: Jack would always say, “We’re going to Chillicothe, and the job pays $9.” In other words, he was giving everybody a chance to back out if $9 wasn’t enough.

ctx.x: And the pay? I think -- I’m talking about 1943, ’44, and ’42, somewhere, I made max $10 a job. Jack would always say, “We’re going to Chillicothe, and the job pays $9.” In other words, he was giving everybody a chance to back out if $9 wasn’t enough. I thought that was pretty good.
